dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Autoimmune (parainfectious) brainstem and cerebellar encephalitis presenting with ocular flutter and ataxia

ALTERNATIVES:
1. Paraneoplastic cerebellar degeneration with anti-neuronal antibodies (occult small cell lung, breast, or ovarian malignancy)
2. Listeria rhombencephalitis (though absence of fever makes this less likely)
3. Multiple sclerosis presenting with a brainstem/cerebellar syndrome (though typical demyelinating features are absent)
